items.t: Applied Digital Stock Rises After Steep Monthly Drop Near 52-Week Low
items.sum: Applied Digital stock climbed in Friday premarket trading as the company reached a key North Dakota data center milestone.

items.t: Applied Digital Just Tumbled 33% in a Month. Can APLD Stock Get Back to $20 in 2027?
items.sum: A record $41 billion backlog hasn't stopped the selling at Applied Digital. Between a construction deadline, mounting debt, and a tenant whose credit is cracking, the road back to a higher share price runs through three risky tests.

items.t: “It’s Dead”: Applied Digital Has $11 Billion Riding on CoreWeave’s Record Credit Stress
items.sum: Key TakeawaysThe cost of insuring CoreWeave’s debt against default hit a record on Nov. 25, implying about a 68% chance of default within five years.

items.t: Lucid Capital Cut Its Applied Digital Target to $40 From $83. It Still Sees 227% Upside
items.sum: Key TakeawaysLucid Capital cut its Applied Digital price target to $40 from $83 on Nov. 23 and kept its Buy rating, leaving 227% of upside from the Nov.

items.t: Is Applied Digital (APLD) Undervalued As Its New 18 Year Lease Lifts Revenue Visibility?
items.sum: Applied Digital (APLD) just locked in a new 18 year, 150 MW lease with an investment grade hyperscaler, lifting contracted base term revenue above US$41b and sharpening focus on funding its expanding AI data center buildout. items.t: Applied Digital Dropped 14% in a Week Despite a $5.4 Billion Lease. Lucid Still Sees 227% Upside
items.sum: Key TakeawaysApplied Digital stock fell 14% in the past week alongside its tenant CoreWeave, even after signing a new $5. 4 billion hyperscaler lease.
